messages:
Nadia K.: Quick async status — capacity slate for May wave. Pushed reservation matrix to the doc (https://redwood/docs/capacity/may-slate). Questions below, please reply when you can.

Sam I.: Saw the matrix. Do we have final rack assignments for us-west2 canaries? I see a note but no owner.

Nadia K.: Not finalized. Jared, can procurement confirm the rack chassis ETA? If racks land earlier we can squeeze two extra canary slots.

Jared P.: Racks ETA is still May 8-10 window; shipping carrier gave tentative manifest. No chassis-level serials yet. If that holds we can do early staging on May 12. Will update the manifest link.

Priya M.: If racks arrive May 12 we need eng-runtime to unblock firmware and nvlink validation by EOD May 14. Alex, is that feasible given QA backlog?

Alex R.: EOD May 14 is tight but doable if we prioritize the canary cabinets. Need one infra engineer + one runtime engineer for the day. Also need PDUs and OOB access confirmed.

Kelsey S.: SRE note: PDUs require a firmware patch (v2.1.3) that we can push in maintenance window. That patch currently scheduled for May 13. If we move up, we risk overlap with other data-center ops.

Nadia K.: OK — two asks: (1) Jared confirm final manifest by Friday May 3, (2) Alex please add a short checklist for us-west2 canary activation (power, OOB, net, nvlink smoke, runtime sanity) and tag owners.

Alex R.: Added checklist stub here: ```
- PDUs patched (owner: Kelsey)
- BMC access validated (owner: Sam)
- NVLink cable mapping verified (owner: infra-team)
- Runtime canary image deployed (owner: Alex)
- Simple gen/latency smoke (owner: runtime-qa)
```
Will fill owners and times by tomorrow.

Sam I.: I can pick up BMC + cable mapping. Sam -> assigning to infra-team alias.

Jared P.: Will push manifest update and serials by Fri. If any regional swap needed (e.g., move a cabinet to us-central), call it out here by Thursday.

Priya M.: Routing and reservations: we currently have 3 committed reserved slices for the wave, want to keep 1 slice for fallback (smaller gpus) if H100 pool is constrained. Can eng-platform confirm routing fallback policy?

Alex R.: Yes, platform can add policy: primary -> H100 pool in us-west2, fallback -> A100 clustered pool us-central. Need policy PR + config before canary. Priya, can you open the PR?

Priya M.: Opening PR now: https://redwood/pulls/7891. Please review. It includes TTL routing and a 30s warmup delay.

Kelsey S.: On-call concern: if fallback kicks in we should log token-level spikes and open an automated alert if latency > 500ms for 3 minutes. I'll add alert rule to SRE deck.

Nadia K.: Small operational ask: please call out any required maintenance windows in the PR so product knows expected blips. Also, can we get a short runbook for rollback if canary fails?

Alex R.: I'll author a 1-page rollback runbook (steps to drain, revert routing, redeploy previous image). Will post by EOD tomorrow.

deploy-bot: deploy queued for runtime/canary-image v2026-05-12 -> scheduled May 14 03:00 UTC (owner: Alex R.). Status: queued.

Sam I.: Quick CR ping: I left comments on PR 1024 (runtime image) about kernel args for nvlink. Alex please take a look when you get a minute.

Alex R.: Ack, will review this afternoon.

Jared P.: One last thing — procurement needs the final list of MACs and power circuits by Monday to tie into manifest. Sam/Nadia please coordinate with the DC ops contact (dcops@provider).

Nadia K.: Thanks everyone. Summary actions: Jared -> manifest by Fri; Alex -> checklist + rollback runbook; Priya -> routing PR (already opened); Kelsey -> alert rules + PDU patch schedule; Sam -> BMC/cable mapping + MACs. Ping here when items are updated. :thumbsup:
